notes: Imported from data/raw/owid/owid_energy.csv, column "coal_production_twh", years 1990 on (one row per country and year; the latest year with a value is shown, the full series is kept for charts and derived datasets).

Codebook (data/raw/owid/owid_energy.codebook.csv) title: "Coal production"; unit: "terawatt-hours (TWh)"; sources: Energy Institute – Statistical Review of World Energy (2026); Etemad & Luciani – World Energy Production 1800–1985 (1991); U.S. Energy Information Administration – International Energy Data (2026); Smil – Energy Transitions: Global and National Perspectives (2017); National Infrastructure Commission – UK historical energy data (2020).

Rows with a blank iso_code are matched by their "country" name: Kosovo -> XKX; regions, income groups and source-defined aggregates (e.g. "Europe (EI)", "G20 (Ember)", "World") and former states are skipped. A blank cell is kept as missing, never 0.
caveats: OWID fills production for countries not covered by EI from other sources (EIA, historical datasets); the dependence is only computed where EI supply also exists.

scoring.rationale: Input to the fuel net-import dependence; absolute volume on its own.
